title: Latent64 Autoencoder Routing Prefilter Contract
description: Specifies schema, validation gates, and storage contracts for 64-dimensional latent vector space used for ANN prefiltering only (not semantic truth).

latent64_msgpack.purpose: Compact msgpack encoding for Valkey cache only

valkey.use_case: Ephemeral routing hints, not semantic truth

g4_spearman_correlation.description: Latent64 reconstruction must preserve ranking order within 0.85 correlation of original
g4_spearman_correlation.failure_mode: Ranking is inverted or randomized; latent64 unsuitable for reranking

g5_recall_at_100.description: Top-100 candidates retrieved by latent64 ANN must include ≥98% of original top-100
g5_recall_at_100.failure_mode: Missing candidates; ANN prefilter is too aggressive

g6_ndcg20_regression.description: Reranked top-20 after latent64 prefilter must not degrade ≥5% from baseline
g6_ndcg20_regression.failure_mode: Relevance degradation; prefilter is removing high-quality candidates

g7_latency_improvement.description: End-to-end query latency with latent64 prefilter must improve ≥50% vs full 768-d ANN
g7_latency_improvement.failure_mode: No speedup; latent64 encoding overhead dominates

deployment.decision: Continue with latent64 as *routing research* (Valkey cache only), deploy content/summary/title named vectors as semantic truth. Do not use latent64 for HNSW prefilter until Spearman >0.85.

latent64.purpose: Routing research only, not semantic search

timeline.decision: Keep latent64 for research; ship content/summary/title vectors
next_steps: Archive latent64 as research artifact (Valkey cache only)
Deploy multi-vector lanes (content, summary, title) as primary retrieval
A/B test multi-vector vs baseline (target: same/better latency + recall)
